fresh_clone_requirements: G6A PASS report present with exact SHA256.
Clone uses --no-hardlinks to avoid sharing Git object files with the source repository.
Fresh clone initially contains none of the 12 external assets.
Install and SHA256-verify all 12 external assets.
Run the public scripts/reproduce_release.py entry point.
Run git fsck --full in the fresh clone.
Fresh clone must remain Git-clean after reproduction.
Candidate commit in the attestation must exactly equal source HEAD.
prohibitions: Do not delete or overwrite an existing fresh-clone directory.
Do not modify the source repository during fresh-clone audit.
Do not create or push a tag unless the fresh-clone attestation is PASS.
Do not push to GitHub or upload to Zenodo automatically.
purpose: Prove the exact candidate release commit reproduces successfully from a fresh Git clone when the separately distributed frozen external assets are installed, then permit creation of the annotated paper-v1.0.0 tag on that exact tested commit.
scientific_guardrails: Final event-track evidence remains single-initialization, Seed 42.
G3 is checkpoint-inference parity, not training-from-scratch reproduction.
No thresholds, models, training, or TEST decisions are changed.
tag_requirements: Attested candidate commit exactly equals current HEAD.
Create an annotated local tag only; do not push automatically.
